question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is "deficiency."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 

__
 
• The reason to use **"deficiency"** in the blank is to indicate a lack or shortage of iron in the body, which can lead to various health problems. (शरीर में आयरन की कमी या कमी, जिससे विभिन्न स्वास्थ्य समस्याएं हो सकती हैं)
 
• **"Deficiency" **clearly conveys the idea that there is a lack or insufficiency of iron, leading to health issues.
 
• It specifies the condition of insufficient iron levels, which is the underlying cause of anaemia, fatigue, brain fog, and tiredness mentioned in the sentence.
 
• Given the symptoms mentioned (anaemia, fatigue, brain fog, and tiredness), **"deficiency"** accurately describes the underlying cause of these health problems, which is a lack of iron.
 
• The correct answer is **Option 1**.

• **Inadequacy: **the fact that something is not good enough or is too small in amount. (तथ्य यह है कि कोई चीज़ पर्याप्त रूप से अच्छी नहीं है या मात्रा में बहुत कम है)
 
• **Lack: **the state of not having something or not having enough of something. (किसी वस्‍तु का अभाव या कमी या पर्याप्त मात्रा में न होना)
 
• **Drought: **a long period without rain. (लम्बी अवधि तक वर्षा न होना, सूखा, अनावृष्टि)
